title: 719. Number of Distinct Islands II

examples.explanation: Two L-shaped islands of different sizes? Actually both single-plus-one shapes are rotations of each other, so they count as one shape.
Two 2x2 squares are identical under translation, so there is one distinct shape.
A single cell and a domino are different even after rotation or reflection.

hints: Collect each island with flood fill, then normalize: translate points so the minimum is at the origin and sort them.
Generate all 8 rotations/reflections of the point set and keep the lexicographically smallest normalized encoding as the canonical key.
Count distinct canonical keys in a hash set.
